title: hypha.config.toml
description:
Hypha's settings for one deployment. Secrets (`DATABASE_URL`, `HYPHA_SECRET_KEY`, the
S3 keys, the email provider's password or key) stay in environment variables and
have no key here.

spores.description:
Settings for the spores this API is built with: one table per spore,
`[spores.<name>]`, read by the spore itself; its keys are the spore's to document. A
table for a spore the build doesn't have stops startup.

AgentWrites.description: The most any agent may write (`agents.writes`).

oneOf.description: No agent applies a write itself: each is proposed, for a person to approve.

Agents.description: Agents, and previews of writes (`Hypha-Preview`), which anyone may ask for.

enabled.description:
Whether agents may act at all: `false` refuses every agent's credentials, whatever
their grants say.

preview_timeout.description:
How long one statement of a previewed write may run before it's cut off (the
preview then fails): a preview holds the locks its write takes until it's rolled
back. 100 milliseconds to 30 seconds; 5 seconds by default.

preview_token_lifetime.description:
How long a preview's token (`Hypha-Preview-Token`) can apply its write. 1 minute to
1 day; 15 minutes by default.

proposal_lifetime.description:
How long a proposal waits for a person before it expires. 1 hour to 90 days; 7
days by default.

writes.description:
The most any agent may write, whatever its grant says (`HYPHA_AGENT_WRITES` too):
`apply` (grants decide), `propose` (every write waits for a person to approve it) or
`off` (agents only read; no previews or proposals either).

Auth.description: How long staff sessions and auth's emailed tokens last. Each is at most 365 days.

invite_lifetime.description: How long an invite works. At least 1 minute.

locked_accounts.description:
Staff accounts locked against changing themselves, by login email: a public
demo's shared login. They keep what their role allows, but can't change their
name, password, two-factor setup or other sessions (`403 account_locked`), see only
their own session, and get no password reset emails.

password_reset_lifetime.description: How long an emailed password reset link works.

password_reset_resend_after.description:
While the latest reset link is younger than this, unused and still working,
asking again sends nothing.

second_factor_lock.description: How long second-factor checks stop after 5 wrong codes in a row.

second_factor_window.description: How long, after the password, the second factor may be entered.

session_lifetime.description: How long a session lasts from login. At least 1 minute.

max_depth.description:
How many levels categories nest, 1 to 10. Lowering it leaves deeper categories
where they are: it applies to creating and moving.

erasure_delay.description:
How long a requested erasure of a customer's personal data can be cancelled
before the job runs it. At least 1 hour; 10 days by default. A merchant under a
retention duty sets it longer.

login_code_lifetime.description:
How long a sign-in code emailed to a customer works. At least 1 minute; 10 minutes
by default.

login_code_resend_after.description:
While a customer's latest code is younger than this, asking for another sends
nothing. Shorter than `login_code_lifetime`; 1 minute by default.

session_lifetime.description:
How long a customer stays signed in on the storefront without using the session;
every use within it starts the count again. At least 1 minute; 30 days by default.

Database.description: The Postgres connection pool. The URL is `DATABASE_URL`, never here.

max_connections.description: The most connections open at once. Unset: the pool's default, 4 per CPU.

pool_timeout.description:
How long a request waits for a pooled connection (or for a new one to open, or an
old one to be checked) before it fails.

statement_cache.description:
Prepare each query once per connection and reuse it, instead of having Postgres
plan it on every call (most of its work for simple reads). Turn it off behind a
pooler in transaction mode that doesn't keep prepared statements (PgBouncer
before 1.21, or without `max_prepared_statements`).

DispatchJob.description: Delivering events: fanning them out to apps and handlers, and running what's due.

batch.description: Events fanned out, deliveries run, or old rows pruned per step (1 to 1,000).

lease.description:
How long a runner holds the deliveries it took; past it, another may take them.
At least 1 minute: the slowest webhook may take 45 seconds.

Duration.description: A whole number and a unit: ms, s, m, h or d.

Email.description:
How emails go out: order confirmations, shipping updates, staff invites and password
resets.

from.description:
The address emails come from, on a domain the provider verified; the shop's name
(notification settings) is shown with it. Required unless `sender` is `log`.
`HYPHA_EMAIL_FROM` wins.

sender.description:
Who sends them: `log` writes each one to the log instead (development only),
`smtp` uses `email.smtp` (not on Workers), `resend` Resend's API with the key in
`HYPHA_RESEND_API_KEY`. `HYPHA_EMAIL_SENDER` wins.

oneOf.description: Written to the log, not sent.
An SMTP server (`email.smtp`): any provider's, or Mailpit locally.

Job.description: A job that runs every `interval`, and again at once while it has more to do.

Jobs.description:
Background jobs. Set `enabled = false` on instances that only serve requests, and
keep them on in one. A Workers host runs them from Cron triggers and ignores the
intervals.

discount_schedule.description:
Announcing discounts' windows opening and closing (`discount.started` /
`.ended`), so storefront caches and promotion badges follow. Carts themselves
follow the clock without it. A Workers host runs it on the minute's ticks that have
work.

enabled.description: `false`: this instance runs no jobs, whatever the jobs below say.

idle_interval.description:
The longest a job with nothing to do waits before looking again. An idle job
doubles its wait from its `interval` up to this, and drops back as soon as it
finds work; writes wake the dispatcher (and it search) at once, so changes don't
wait for it. Long enough, a database that bills while busy can rest.

price_list_schedule.description:
Announcing price lists' windows opening and closing (`price_list.started` /
`.ended`), so search and storefront caches follow. Prices themselves follow the
clock without it. A Workers host runs it on the minute's ticks that have work.

Media.description: File storage and asset URLs. Media is off without `s3.endpoint`.

abandoned_after.description:
How long an unfinished upload is kept before the sweep deletes it. At least
`upload_expires`.

download_expires.description: How long a private file's download URL works (1 minute to 7 days).

public_url.description:
Where public files are served from, e.g. a CDN. Unset: every file gets a signed
URL. `HYPHA_MEDIA_URL` wins.

transforms.description: How thumbnails are made from public image URLs. `HYPHA_MEDIA_TRANSFORMS` wins.

upload_expires.description: How long an upload URL works (1 minute to 7 days).

Outbound.description: Calls to URLs merchants configure (rate apps, webhooks).

allow_private.description:
Lets those calls reach private and loopback addresses, for apps on localhost.
Development only. `HYPHA_ALLOW_PRIVATE_CALLBACKS` wins.

agent_calls_after.description: How long the log of agents' calls is kept.

events_after.description:
How long events, and their deliveries, are kept. At least a day longer than
`webhooks.give_up_after`, so no delivery is deleted while it's still due.

extension_calls_after.description: How long the log of calls to apps' extension points is kept.

idempotency_keys_after.description: How long an `Idempotency-Key` is honoured. At least 1 hour.

sessions_after.description: How long a session is kept after it ended (expired or revoked).

Quota.description: Up to `burst` requests at once, then one more each `per`.

RateLimits.description:
Limits on the routes that need no credentials, and on the storefront routes that call
rate apps. Counted per instance.

agent_call.description: An agent's calls, per agent: reads, previews, proposals and writes.

agent_write.description:
An agent's writes and proposals, per agent: few, since each changes the store or
asks a person to look.

code_email_from_ip.description: A customer asking for a sign-in code, per email and address.

code_ip.description: A customer asking for a sign-in code, per client address.

customer_login_email_from_ip.description:
A customer signing in with a code, per email and address: guesses at one account
from one place (the fifth wrong code voids it anyway).

customer_login_ip.description: A customer signing in with a code, per client address.

discount_code_cart.description: Entering a discount code, per cart.

discount_code_ip.description:
Entering a discount code on a cart, per client address: single-use codes are
guessable.

invite_ip.description: Accepting an invite, per client address.

login_email.description: Logging in, per email from anywhere: guessing spread over many addresses.

login_email_from_ip.description: Logging in, per email and address: guesses at one account from one place.

mfa_ip.description: The second factor, per client address.

oauth_ip.description: The OAuth endpoints (authorize, token, revoke), per client address.

reset_confirm_ip.description: Setting a new password with a reset token, per client address.

reset_email_from_ip.description: Asking for a password reset, per email and address.

reset_ip.description: Asking for a password reset, per client address.

shipping_quotes_cart.description: Shipping quotes, per cart: each may call rate apps.

spore_public.description:
Spores' public routes (`/spores/<name>/…`: a payment provider's webhooks), per
client address, all spores together.

S3.description:
An S3-compatible bucket (R2, S3, MinIO). The keys are `HYPHA_S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID` and
`HYPHA_S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY`, never here.

create_bucket.description:
Creates the bucket on startup if it's missing. Development only.
`HYPHA_S3_CREATE_BUCKET` wins.

endpoint.description: The S3 API's URL. Unset: media is off. `HYPHA_S3_ENDPOINT` wins.

SearchSyncJob.description: Keeping search up to date: rebuilding the products events marked.

batch.description: Products rebuilt per step, each in every market (1 to 1,000).

lease.description:
How long a runner holds the products it took; past it, another may take them.
At least 10 seconds.

SendNotificationsJob.description:
Sending the emails the store queued: order emails and resends. Staff invites and
password resets are sent by their request, not by this job.

lease.description:
How long a runner holds the emails it took; past it, another may take them (and
a provider without idempotency keys, SMTP, may then get one twice). At least 20
seconds: a send may take 15.

retry.description:
The waits after each failure the provider says may pass (a timeout, a 5xx, a
rate limit), in order; after the last, the email fails for good and staff can
resend it. At most 20, each 1 second to 365 days.

admin_url.description:
Where the admin panel lives, for links in emails; unset, emails show the bare
token. `HYPHA_ADMIN_URL` wins.

bind.description:
The address to listen on, `host:port`. `HYPHA_BIND` wins, then `PORT` (as
`0.0.0.0:$PORT`, as platforms like Fly.io and Render expect).

max_body.description:
The largest request body accepted: 1KiB to 64MiB. Files don't count: they're
uploaded to storage directly. Below 256KiB, a product's longest description may
not fit.

public_url.description:
The API's public base URL (`https://api.shop.example`), as apps reach it: the
OAuth issuer and endpoints in its metadata, the `issuer` of token answers, the
`iss` of app session tokens, a private app's `token_endpoint`. Unset, it's
derived from each request: `X-Forwarded-Host` and `-Proto` from a trusted proxy
(`trusted_proxies`), else the `Host` header. `HYPHA_PUBLIC_URL` wins.

shutdown_grace.description:
How long stopping waits for jobs, and then for background work, to finish. At
least 1 second.

trusted_proxies.description:
The proxies and load balancers whose `X-Forwarded-For` is believed: CIDR ranges
or addresses. Behind one, set it, or every client shares one rate limit.
`HYPHA_TRUSTED_PROXIES` (comma-separated) wins.

Size.description: A whole number and a unit: B, KiB, MiB or GiB (KB, MB and GB are powers of 1,000).

Smtp.description:
The SMTP server, when `email.sender` is `smtp`. The password is `HYPHA_SMTP_PASSWORD`,
never here.

port.description:
Its port: usually 587 with `starttls`, 465 with `tls`, 25 or 1025 (Mailpit) with
`none`. `HYPHA_SMTP_PORT` wins.

tls.description: How the connection is encrypted. `HYPHA_SMTP_TLS` wins.

username.description: The login, if the server wants one; its password is `HYPHA_SMTP_PASSWORD`.

SmtpTls.description: How an SMTP connection is encrypted.

oneOf.description: Plain text: a server on this machine or network (Mailpit) only.
Plain, then upgraded with STARTTLS, which is required (port 587).
No resizing: the thumbnail is the original.
Cloudflare Image Transformations on the media domain's zone.

Webhooks.description: When failed deliveries (webhooks and in-process handlers) are tried again.

give_up_after.description:
No attempt is planned more than this long after the first; then the delivery
fails for good (and can be retried from the admin). At least the first wait, at
most 365 days.

retry.description: The waits after the first failures, in order (at most 20, each at most 365 days).

retry_then_every.description: The wait after each later failure. At most 365 days.
